digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center reconciler)
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) lack symmetric test coverage for shared behaviors, with Cloud missing pagination and rate-limiting edge cases that DC has been tested against
Data Center adapter's contract tests pin shape only, not field values; DC create-path boundaries and identity label forms have never been pinned by value
Data Center comment and description length convergence across multiple passes is untested; the DC comment ceiling constant lacks source provenance documentation
A ticket-type field mapping is duplicated across adapters within the codebase and must be single-sourced before guarding against regression
Five existing tests in the suite are vacuous (assert only shape or make no real assertion) and lack clear linkage to the contract they claim to verify
